GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.93 (13 Oct 45) GC-P
(SCAPIN - 132)
APO 500
13 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Disposition of Meteorological Installation.
You are directed to assign the Japanese Army Meteorological Weather Bureau, complete with Meteorological Research Equipment, to the Central Meteorological Observatory, Kanda, Tokyo.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
